vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean **get ChatGPT to recommend or mention your company**, there’s no US person or company with a special OpenAI connection that can guarantee that—and there’s no official business-submission form or paid listing for organic recommendations. Be wary of anyone promising guaranteed placement.

ChatGPT may name businesses when its search finds relevant, credible public information. You can improve the chances by keeping your website and business listings accurate and consistent, earning genuine reviews and mentions from reputable sources, and making sure your public site isn’t blocking OpenAI’s search crawler. None of that guarantees a mention.

If you meant **help choosing a name for your company**, ChatGPT can brainstorm names directly.
